SELECT
  'wr-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-wholesale_return-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS batch_id,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${date-1d}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(o.wholesale_return_fid AS VARCHAR) AS wholesale_return_fid,
  CAST(o.wholesale_order_fid AS VARCHAR) AS order_no,
  CAST(o.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
  CAST(o.client_fid AS VARCHAR) AS client_fid,
  CAST(o.wholesale_return_audit_time AS VARCHAR) AS audit_time,
  CAST(o.wholesale_return_total_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS total_money,
  CAST(o.wholesale_return_cost_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS cost_money,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.order_detail_num') AS VARCHAR) AS order_detail_num,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.item_num') AS BIGINT) AS item_num,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.return_detail_money') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS return_detail_money,
  CAST(json_extract_string(u.d, '$.return_detail_cost_money') AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS return_detail_cost_money
FROM input o
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(from_json(CAST(o.wholesale_return_details AS JSON), '["JSON"]')) AS u(d)
